intro: This archive collects 7 articles tagged `pypi` published between April 27, 2026 and May 14, 2026, giving security teams a focused view of how this topic has appeared across ZCyberNews coverage. Observed actor references include TeamPCP, OceanLotus, and ZiChatBot, presented only where the underlying article metadata supports the attribution. The affected-scope signals emphasize technology, software development, and research across Global, helping readers compare exposure patterns without adding claims beyond the archive data. Severity coverage includes 4 critical, and 3 high reports.
